# Ibrahim Benabida — Data Scientist & Digital Designer

> Official machine-readable entity profile for Ibrahim Benabida (`ibrahim.`).

## Summary
Ibrahim Benabida is a 19-year-old Data Science undergraduate at USTHB (University of Science and Technology Houari Boumediene) and a digital designer based in Algiers, Algeria. He bridges analytical computing, machine learning, and mathematical modeling with refined visual design systems and frontend engineering.

## Key Disciplines & Expertise
- **Data Science & Machine Learning**: Mathematical modeling, statistical analysis, algorithmic optimization, Python computational stacks.
- **Visual Design & Brand Systems**: 137.5° phyllotaxis golden angle identity systems, typography hierarchies, grid systems, high-contrast palette design.
- **Frontend Engineering**: Production web development with React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS; fluid responsive layouts, micro-interactions, zero horizontal scroll.

## Featured Projects
- **Golden Angle Brand Identity**: Mathematical spiral brand manual uniting computational data science with architectural typography based on the 137.5° golden angle.
- **Clinical Management & Patient Flow**: High-density medical dashboard and clinic appointment portal balancing clinical usability with high performance.
- **GridCraft Engine**: Interactive procedural grid and pattern generator exploring mathematical tessellations.
